name: Differential Equations: Odelo
subtitle: Differential Equations Course
shortDescription: Adaptive differential equations course: practice that learns from your mistakes, interactive labs and full worked solutions. Free to use.
longDescription:
Odelo is an adaptive differential equations course for second-year undergraduates. Study first-order differential equations (separable, linear, exact), modelling, existence and uniqueness, second-order linear differential equations, Laplace transforms, systems and phase portraits, numerical methods (Euler, Runge-Kutta) and series solutions.

### What makes it different
- Personalised adaptive path or traditional course order; switch any time.
- Practice that learns from your mistakes: it spots the slip behind a wrong answer, schedules spaced review and picks the next question for you.
- More than 280 original practice questions with full worked solutions, timed unit tests and three mock finals.
- Five interactive labs: slope fields, spring-mass-damper, phase portraits and eigenvalues, Euler versus Runge-Kutta, predator-prey.
- Tap any concept for a short explanation from school level up to graduate level, plus clear before-this-course and after-this-course pages.
- Every source is cited and linked (such as MIT OpenCourseWare, OpenStax, Khan Academy, Coursera, edX, textbooks and authoritative videos); nothing is copied.

Free with optional ads at natural breaks, with an optional monthly ad-free plan. Explanations are never locked, and no account is needed. Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any university, course provider or publisher named in the app.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
